code: Canadian Electrical Code (CSA C22.1), Section 28 - Motors and Generators
voltage_mapping: Table columns are by RATED motor voltage: 208 V system motors rated 208 V use the 208 column; motors rated 208-220 V use the 230 column per the table notes; 240 V system -> 230 column; 480 V -> 460; 600 V -> 575.
provenance: CSA C22.1 is paywalled. These Table 44 values are assembled from manufacturer reproductions (Schneider Electric digest, ABB catalogue, Moeller chart citing CEC Tables 44/45) that agree on every cell of the 1-50 HP subset, with Canadian course-material cross-checks (20 HP at 575 V = 22 A; 25 HP at 575 V = 27 A).

rules.branch_conductors_28_106: Ampacity not less than 125% of the motor full-load current (Table 44/45 value, not nameplate) for continuous-duty motors.

branch_ocpd_28_200_table_29.rounding: If the result is not a standard Table 13 rating, select the next SMALLER standard rating (rounding up is not permitted here).

rules.starting_relief_28_200_4: Where the Table 29 device will not let the motor start: non-time-delay fuse up to 400% (fuses up to 600 A) or 300% (601-6000 A); time-delay fuse up to 225%; inverse-time breaker up to 400% (breakers up to 100 A) or 300% (over 100 A).
rules.overloads_28_306: Overload protection is sized from the motor NAMEPLATE current: not more than 125% where the service factor is 1.15 or higher, otherwise 115%. (Not from Table 44.)
rules.feeder_conductors: Ampacity not less than 125% of the largest motor FLC plus 100% of the sum of all other motor FLCs (Rules 28-106/28-108).
rules.feeder_ocpd_28_204: Rating not more than the largest motor's Table 29 maximum plus the sum of the other motors' FLCs (plus other loads at their values).
rules.disconnect_28_602_28_604: One of: a motor-circuit switch with a horsepower rating not less than the motor; a moulded-case switch or circuit breaker rated not less than 115% of FLC; or an instantaneous-trip breaker per Rule 28-210.
